description: Build the public, mobile-first, SEO-optimized salon landing page with a lead/appointment booking form that delivers leads instantly to the owner via free WhatsApp click-to-chat (wa.me) and persists each lead to localStorage. This is the core lead-generation surface. Dependency-free: HTML + CSS + vanilla JS only (npm registry is blocked, so NO external packages).
steps: Create assets/js/config.js exporting (as a global window.SALON_CONFIG object, no ES module import needed) the centralized salon configuration: salonName ('A Plus Salon'), tagline, ownerWhatsApp (phone in international format WITHOUT '+' or spaces, e.g. '919999999999' as a clearly-marked placeholder the owner must edit), displayPhone, address, city, businessHours, socialLinks, and a services array where each item has {id, name, priceFrom, durationMins, description}. Add clear comments telling the owner exactly which fields to edit. Provide at least 6 realistic salon services (e.g. Haircut & Styling, Hair Color, Facial, Manicure & Pedicure, Bridal Makeup, Hair Spa).

Create index.html: semantic HTML5 with a mobile-first responsive structure. Sections: sticky header/nav with salon name + 'Book Now' CTA; hero with headline, subtext, primary CTA scrolling to the booking form and a secondary WhatsApp CTA; services section rendered from window.SALON_CONFIG.services via main.js (show name, priceFrom, duration, description as cards); 'Why choose us'/benefits strip; a booking/lead form section; a contact/footer with address, hours, phone (tel: link) and WhatsApp link. Include full SEO meta: title, description, viewport, canonical, Open Graph + Twitter card tags, theme-color, and a JSON-LD script with schema.org LocalBusiness/HairSalon (name, address, telephone, openingHours, priceRange). Reference assets/css/styles.css, assets/js/config.js then assets/js/main.js (config before main).

Build the booking/lead form in index.html: fields for Full Name (required), Phone (required, tel input), Service (required select populated from config services via main.js), Preferred Date (date input), Preferred Time (time or select of slots), and an optional Message/notes textarea. Include a hidden honeypot field for basic spam protection. Mark required fields and add proper labels, autocomplete attributes, and aria attributes for accessibility.

Create assets/js/main.js (vanilla JS, wrapped in DOMContentLoaded, uses window.SALON_CONFIG): (a) render service cards into the services section and options into the form's service select; (b) inject dynamic content that depends on config (salon name in header/footer/title fallback, phone tel: links, prefilled generic WhatsApp CTA link built from ownerWhatsApp using https://wa.me/<number>?text=<encoded>); (c) implement client-side form validation (required fields, phone format sanity check, honeypot must be empty) with inline error messages; (d) on valid submit: build a human-readable lead message string containing all field values, save the lead object {name, phone, service, date, time, message, createdAt ISO timestamp, id} into localStorage under key 'aplus_salon_leads' (append to existing JSON array), then open the owner's WhatsApp with the prefilled message via window.open of a wa.me URL (encodeURIComponent the message), and show an on-page success confirmation. Do NOT lose the lead if the popup is blocked — still save to localStorage and show a fallback clickable WhatsApp link.

Create assets/css/styles.css: single mobile-first stylesheet using CSS custom properties for a cohesive salon-appropriate palette (elegant, modern), system-font stack fallback so it looks good even if a webfont fails to load, responsive layout via flexbox/grid with breakpoints for tablet/desktop, styled nav, hero, service cards, form controls with visible focus states, buttons (primary + WhatsApp green), success/error message styles, and a polished footer. Ensure tap targets are >=44px and the layout is fully usable at 360px width.

Create assets/img/ with a lightweight inline-friendly SVG logo/favicon and a simple og-image (SVG or a small placeholder). Wire favicon and og:image references in index.html. Keep images dependency-free (SVG or tiny placeholders), no external downloads.
acceptance_criteria: index.html loads over `python3 -m http.server` and returns HTTP 200 with the salon name and a visible booking form.
`NODE_OPTIONS="" node --check assets/js/config.js` and `... node --check assets/js/main.js` both pass with no syntax errors.
Service cards and the form's service dropdown are populated from config (changing config.js services changes what renders).

Submitting the form with valid data (a) appends a lead to localStorage key 'aplus_salon_leads' and (b) constructs a valid https://wa.me/<ownerWhatsApp>?text=... URL containing the encoded lead details; submitting with missing required fields shows inline validation errors and does not save.
Page is mobile-responsive: no horizontal overflow at 360px width; contains viewport meta and JSON-LD LocalBusiness/HairSalon schema plus Open Graph tags.
No external npm/package dependencies are introduced; all JS/CSS is local vanilla code.
verification: Run `NODE_OPTIONS="" node --check assets/js/config.js && NODE_OPTIONS="" node --check assets/js/main.js` and confirm exit 0.

Start `python3 -m http.server 8000` from repo root, then `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8000/index.html` returns 200, and `curl -s http://localhost:8000/index.html` output contains the booking form and the salon name.

Grep the built index.html/main.js to confirm the wa.me URL construction and localStorage key 'aplus_salon_leads' are present, and confirm all referenced local assets (css/js/img) exist on disk (no broken paths).
findings: Built dependency-free static landing page at repo root. Files created: index.html, assets/css/styles.css, assets/js/config.js, assets/js/main.js, assets/img/{logo.svg,favicon.svg,og-image.svg}. config.js exposes window.SALON_CONFIG (plain script, loaded before main.js) with salonName 'A Plus Salon', tagline, ownerWhatsApp placeholder '919999999999' (clearly commented EDIT ME), displayPhone, address, city, businessHours, socialLinks, currencySymbol, and 8 services (>=6 required) each {id,name,priceFrom,durationMins,description}. index.html is semantic/mobile-first with full SEO (title, meta description, viewport, canonical, OG x6, Twitter card, theme-color, JSON-LD HairSalon schema), sticky nav w/ Book Now + mobile toggle, hero (primary + WhatsApp CTA), services (rendered by main.js from config), benefits strip, booking form, footer. Booking form fields: name(required), phone(required tel), service(required select from config), date, time(select of slots), message(optional), + hidden honeypot field name='company'. main.js (DOMContentLoaded, IIFE): injects config content incl phone tel: links + generic wa.me CTA, renders service cards + populates select, client-side validation with inline errors + honeypot check, on valid submit saves lead {id,name,phone,service,date,time,message,createdAt ISO} appended to localStorage array key 'aplus_salon_leads', opens https://wa.me/<number>?text=<encodeURIComponent msg>, shows success + fallback clickable WhatsApp link if popup blocked (lead never lost). styles.css single mobile-first sheet with CSS custom properties, system-font fallback, breakpoints 600/900px, >=44px tap targets, focus states, WhatsApp-green button, success/error styles. VERIFICATION: NODE_OPTIONS="" node --check passed for config.js and main.js (exit 0); python3 -m http.server smoke test returned 200 for index.html and all 6 assets; index.html output contains 'A Plus Salon' (10x) and id='booking-form'; confirmed 'aplus_salon_leads', 'https://wa.me/', encodeURIComponent, JSON-LD (1), og: tags (6), viewport (1) present. ENV NOTE: httpd smoke test must be run as a single self-contained bash command (start server backgrounded + curl + kill in one invocation); the run_in_background flag and standalone long-running server commands are rejected by the sandbox's long-running-command guard. NODE_OPTIONS="" prefix required for all node calls as documented. FEAT-002 scope (admin.html, admin.js, vercel.json, README, robots/sitemap) intentionally NOT built.
